paragraphs.source_en:
The
song that I came to sing remains unsung to this day.

units.source_en:
The
song that I came to sing remains unsung to this day.

paragraphs.source_en: I have spent my days in stringing and in unstringing my instrument.

units.source_en: I have spent my days in stringing and in unstringing my instrument.

paragraphs.source_en: The time has not come true, the words have not been rightly set; only there is the agony of wishing in my heart.

units.source_en: The time has not come true, the words have not been rightly set; only there is the agony of wishing in my heart.

paragraphs.source_en: The blossom has not opened; only the wind is sighing by.

units.source_en: The blossom has not opened; only the wind is sighing by.

paragraphs.source_en: I have not seen his face, nor have I listened to his voice; only I have heard his gentle footsteps from the road before my house.

units.source_en: I have not seen his face, nor have I listened to his voice; only I have heard his gentle footsteps from the road before my house.

paragraphs.source_en: The livelong day has passed in spreading his seat on the floor; but the lamp has not been lit and I cannot ask him into my house.

units.source_en: The livelong day has passed in spreading his seat on the floor; but the lamp has not been lit and I cannot ask him into my house.

paragraphs.source_en: I live in the hope of meeting with him; but this meeting is not yet.

units.source_en: I live in the hope of meeting with him; but this meeting is not yet.
